title: Copyright Boundary Basics

source_refs.title: Copyright Law of the People's Republic of China

originality_declaration: Original explanatory writing based on an official legal source; no third-party course material or question-bank content is included.

body.summary: Public learning content can safely start from official legal texts, public facts, and original analysis. The platform should still avoid copying third-party explanations, examples, and teaching material.
learning_points: Official legal and administrative documents can be referenced as source material, but platform explanations should be written independently.
Mere factual information can support a knowledge point, while creative expression around those facts may still carry rights.
A content item should record its source and origin policy so reviewers can audit why it belongs in the public repository.
body.review_prompt: When reviewing a knowledge item, separate source facts from the author's explanatory expression.
